package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"time"

	"github.com/prince776/go-dst-kit/realworld"
)

var __w = realworld.New(realworld.Options{})

func pipeRead(r *io.PipeReader) string { b, _ := io.ReadAll(r); return string(b) }

// Pipes, sockets and HTTP: the same output whichever World runs it.
func main() {
	r, w := io.Pipe()
	go func() { w.Write([]byte("through a pipe")); w.Close() }()
	fmt.Println(pipeRead(r))

	a, b := net.Pipe()
	go func() { a.Write([]byte("net pipe")); a.Close() }()
	got, _ := io.ReadAll(b)
	fmt.Println(string(got))

	ln, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("listen:", err)
		return
	}
	go func() {
		for {
			c, err := ln.Accept()
			if err != nil {
				return
			}
			c.Write([]byte("tcp hello"))
			c.Close()
		}
	}()
	for _, dial := range []func() (net.Conn, error){
		func() (net.Conn, error) { return net.Dial("tcp", ln.Addr().String()) },
		func() (net.Conn, error) { return net.DialTimeout("tcp", ln.Addr().String(), time.Second) },
	} {
		c, err := dial()
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Println("dial:", err)
			return
		}
		got, _ := io.ReadAll(c)
		fmt.Println(string(got))
		c.Close()
	}
	ln.Close()

	hl, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("listen:", err)
		return
	}
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.HandleFunc("/", func(rw http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) { rw.Write([]byte("http hello")) })
	go http.Serve(hl, mux)
	http.DefaultClient.Timeout = 5 * time.Second
	resp, err := http.Get("http://" + hl.Addr().String() + "/")
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("get:", err)
		return
	}
	body, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	resp.Body.Close()
	fmt.Println(string(body), resp.StatusCode, http.DefaultClient.Timeout)
}
